AVOCADOMINI / TOWER20 E3

From design
to measured prototype.

avocadoMini Tower20 E3 uses four fixed-height 200 mm input towers around one separate low Edge Hub. Funding, payments, and early reservations have not started.

01 / FIRST MILESTONE

Prove the E3 assumptions on one integrated prototype.

  1. Validate 200 mm tower height, four-foot stability, cable strain, sliding, heat, and optical packaging.
  2. Measure four-camera USB throughput, capture timing, calibration, center-ROI tracking, and body-to-display latency on the selected Hub.
  3. Verify local push-to-talk Japanese voice, privacy cutoffs, signed recovery, cooling, acoustics, and saved-work recovery.

02 / PRICE

Current planned base price for the complete system (before tax): ¥410,000

This is the current plan for four Tower20 units plus one Edge Hub. Tax, shipping, delivery, final specifications, and sales terms are not yet finalized.

Funding has not started

The platform, target, rewards, and delivery terms are still undecided. No support payment is collected on this page.
